description: NaCP₂H₅O₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PCO₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.90 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PCO₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.71 Å. C is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two P and two H atoms. There is one shorter (1.81 Å) and one longer (1.83 Å) C-P bond length. Both C-H bond lengths are 1.10 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to one C and three O atoms to form PCO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PCO₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-58°. There is one shorter (1.51 Å) and two longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to one C and three O atoms to form distorted PCO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PCO₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-58°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. There are five inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.04 Å) and one longer (1.51 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.10 Å) and one longer (1.37 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.04 Å) and one longer (1.50 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom.
